title: Engineering Lead
description: You'll ship agents that move money, and you'll keep the rhythm that gets them shipped. Accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury: autonomous agents that read the invoice, match it, negotiate the discount, release the payment, and reconcile the cash. Every one of those actions runs in production with a customer's CFO watching the result. Most of what the industry calls engineering culture was written for a world where humans typed every line. That world ended. We want to build the 2026 version: engineers who work with agents as a matter of course, where the unit of work is the loop (spec, generate, evaluate, correct, ship) rather than the ticket, where code review means reviewing the evals and prompts as hard as the diff, and where a regression suite over real customer invoices is what lets us move fast on systems that touch money. Nobody has a settled playbook for this. You'll help write ours, from inside a pod. This is a player-coach role. You'll spend most of your week shipping code in one of our pods, and you'll manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, growth, the hard conversation when it's needed. The rest goes to the delivery rhythm: pods commit to milestones in Linear, post progress daily, and review misses every Friday with the Head of Product and the CTO. You run that review and the follow-ups. The management share grows as we go from 8 engineers to 16 and beyond; this role is the natural path to Head of Engineering. You'll report to the CTO. Causa Prima is built by the team behind Taulia and backed by Creandum. What you'll do Ship as a senior engineer, 70 to 80% of your week. Take the hardest work in your pod, unblock the integration nobody wants, and review the code that touches money personally. You set the bar by clearing it in front of the team. raw.description:
You'll ship agents that move money, and you'll keep the rhythm that gets them shipped. Accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury: autonomous agents that read the invoice, match it, negotiate the discount, release the payment, and reconcile the cash. Every one of those actions runs in production with a customer's CFO watching the result.

Most of what the industry calls engineering culture was written for a world where humans typed every line. That world ended. We want to build the 2026 version: engineers who work with agents as a matter of course, where the unit of work is the loop (spec, generate, evaluate, correct, ship) rather than the ticket, where code review means reviewing the evals and prompts as hard as the diff, and where a regression suite over real customer invoices is what lets us move fast on systems that touch money. Nobody has a settled playbook for this. You'll help write ours, from inside a pod.

This is a player-coach role. You'll spend most of your week shipping code in one of our pods, and you'll manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, growth, the hard conversation when it's needed. You run that review and the follow-ups. The management share grows as we go from 8 engineers to 16 and beyond; this role is the natural path to Head of Engineering. You'll report to the CTO. Causa Prima is built by the team behind Taulia and backed by Creandum.

What you'll do

  • Ship as a senior engineer, 70 to 80% of your week. Take the hardest work in your pod, unblock the integration nobody wants, and review the code that touches money personally. You set the bar by clearing it in front of the team.

  • Manage the engineers day to day. Weekly 1:1s, direct feedback, growth plans, and the honest conversation about who's ready for more scope and who's in the wrong seat. The CTO owns hiring decisions and the technical direction; the people in the pods are yours.

  • Run the delivery rhythm. Weekly milestone commitments, the Friday review, the dashboard of committed versus delivered, and the follow-ups when something slips. Misses are discussed to learn, not to blame; your job is that they get discussed at all, with an owner and a next step.

  • Make the loop the way we work. Specs written so an agent can execute them, evals that run before merge, review practices that treat prompts as code. The CTO owns the architecture; you own that every pod actually works this way, including the change management when they don't.

description: Staff Engineer You'll be the most senior engineer on the agents that run finance operations for our customers — designing, building, and operating the autonomous agents that handle accounts payable and receivable end-to-end. From invoice validation and dispute resolution to cross-company negotiation and cash optimization. This is an individual-contributor role at the top of our ladder: no direct reports, full technical authority over the architecture the rest of the team builds on. What you'll do Agent architecture — Design the multi-agent system: agent boundaries, event contracts, orchestration patterns, and the separation between LLM reasoning and deterministic enforcement. LLMs inform; rules enforce. You own where that line sits for every action that moves money, and the authorization gateway that makes it non-negotiable. Agentic dispute resolution — An agent that reads the claim, gathers the evidence from the PO, contract, and delivery record, forms a position, and works it to settlement — negotiating with the counterparty where that's appropriate, escalating to a human where it isn't. Deductions and short pays classified, tied to the underlying claim, and driven to resolution rather than parked in an aging bucket. Agentic dynamic discounting — Agents that continuously price early payment against the cash position on both sides of the transaction, propose terms, and execute them. Static payment terms become a negotiation that runs on its own. Matching and reconciliation — Three-way matching across purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice with configurable tolerances; cash application against bank statements and remittance advices, including partial payments and residuals; the exception paths that follow when any of it fails. Unglamorous but important: The foundation everything agentic sits on. Validation & anomaly detection — Business rule checks, duplicate and near-duplicate detection, pricing discrepancy detection, and anomaly detection across time. Precision matters as much as recall here: a false positive is a blocked supplier and an angry procurement lead. Integration framework — ERP systems first and deepest, then banking APIs, accounting platforms, Gmail, Drive, and Slack. Auth model, credential lifecycle, data normalization. Today each connector is a project; you make the next one a configuration. Compliance & security — Agents operate within a zero-trust model. You'll design how agents verify independently against source data, how outbound content is reviewed, and how the system prevents cascading failures from prompt injection. Plus the European e-invoicing mandates now landing across France, Germany, and Spain, and what EN 16931 means for the pipeline. Platform & data infrastructure — Own the primitives every agent action rests on: an append-only PostgreSQL event store with tamper-evident hash chaining for replay and audit; cryptographic signature verification on agent events and approval chains before anything external fires; the Workflow Constraint Engine that gates payments, emails, and API calls on deterministic policy, not model output; row-level multi-tenancy and tenant-scoped credentials across every data store; attribute-based authorization via Cerbos, evaluated the same way whether the caller is an agent or a human; and the MCP security layer — auth, capability-scoping, rate limiting — for external agent-to-agent access. The engineering standard — Architecture decision records, review bar, on-call, and a clear view of what we deliberately don't build. You'll write the things the next ten engineers read in week one, and you'll spend time with controllers and AP leads watching agents fail in ways no test predicted. What we're looking for 8+ years shipping production systems; currently Staff, Principal, Lead IC, or a founding engineer. You've carried an architecture through a scaling step and lived with your own decisions. Strong systems design thinking — agent boundaries, failure modes, trust boundaries, contract evolution. Money movement is not retry-safe by default and you already know why. Depth in Python and/or TypeScript in production, and deep PostgreSQL: event sourcing, row-level security, indexing tradeoffs, schema evolution under load. Hands-on experience with LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or similar), and document AI (LlamaIndex, LlamaParse, or similar). Strong opinions about when to use an LLM vs. a rules engine vs. traditional ML — and the courage to defend them. Experience designing data pipelines, integration architectures, or event-driven systems in production. Security awareness — you think about what happens when untrusted input meets your pipeline, and about segregation of duties before someone makes you. Technical leadership without a title: reviews that teach, designs that get adopted, engineers who get faster because you're there. Effective use of AI coding tools with strong review skills for LLM integration and auth code. Domain knowledge across the purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash cycle. You don't need all three areas below, but you need real depth in one and working fluency in the rest — enough that when a controller describes an exception, you understand it before they finish: Accounts payable — PO and non-PO invoice intake, coding to GL account and cost centre, approval routing and delegation of authority, three-way matching and tolerance handling, blocked-invoice and exception workflows, duplicate detection, payment runs, payment terms and early-payment discounts, supplier master data and bank-detail verification, period-end accruals for un-invoiced receipts. Accounts receivable — invoice issuance and e-invoicing, cash application and remittance matching, partial payments, short pays and residuals, credit memos, deductions and dispute handling, dunning and collections strategy, credit limits and credit risk, aging and DSO. Procurement — requisition to purchase order, supplier onboarding and qualification, catalogues and contract pricing, goods receipt, off-contract and maverick spend, sourcing and supplier negotiation, and the handoff into AP where most of the pain actually lives. Fluency with the systems this runs on: ERPs (NetSuite, Dynamics, or the SMB stack), the sub-ledger to general-ledger relationship, and how period close constrains what an agent is allowed to do and when. title: Consultant Presales & Solutions (m/w/d)
description: Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle. Wer wir sind docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe. Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80 % ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark, und unser Vertrieb liefert immer mehr qualifizierte Termine. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich. Was du machst Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss. Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben. Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation. Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen. Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung. Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar. Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen. Worauf du dich einstellst Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt. Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert. Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann. Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen. Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs. Wen wir suchen Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware. Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt. Du erklärst Technik so, dass eine Geschäftsführung entscheidet und eine IT-Leitung zustimmt. Du bist technisch fit: Schnittstellen, Cloud und On-Premises, Berechtigungen und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut. Programmieren musst du nicht. Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht. Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder anderen DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen Kenntnis der Sozialwirtschaft, des öffentlichen Sektors oder von ERP- und Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen Erfahrung mit E-Rechnung, E-Signatur oder revisionssicherer Archivierung Was dir fehlt, bringen wir dir bei. title: (Senior) Accountant (w/m/d)

Unser vielfältiges Team aus über 350 Mitarbeitenden verbindet Innovationsgeist, Zusammenarbeit und das gemeinsame Ziel, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, ihre Träume zu verwirklichen. Deine Aufgaben: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Themen der Hauptbuchhaltung, insbesondere Rückstellungen, personalbezogene Buchungen sowie Kontenabstimmungen. Du bist aktiv an der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen nach IFRS und deren Überleitung nach HGB für die dir zugeordneten Konzerngesellschaften beteiligt und arbeitest dabei eng mit Controlling, Group Reporting und weiteren Finance-Teams (z. B. Nebenbücher, Tax, Treasury und Investor Relatons), sowie anderen Stakeholdern zusammen. Du treibst die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Automatisierung von Prozessen voran, denkst innovativ und stellst die Einhaltung von Bilanzierungsrichtlinien sowie internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS) sicher. Du pflegst und optimierst relevante Prozessdokumentationen. Du unterstützt aktiv bereichsübergreifende Projekte, insbesondere rund um unsere Online-Plattform sowie bei der Einführung neuer Produkte oder Features. Du trägst durch eine präzise und termingerechte Buchhaltung wesentlich zur Qualität unserer Finanzberichterstattung bei und übernimmst Verantwortung für buchhalterische Themen innerhalb des Hauptbuch-Teams. Was du mitbringst: Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung bzw. Hauptbuchhaltung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel, sowie gängigen Buchhaltungssystemen (MS Dynamics Business Central oder MS Dynamics NAV sind ein Plus). Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive Kommunikation aus. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Cash Management Software (E-Banking Treasurysysteme). Eine Weiterbildung als Bilanzbuchhalter*in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil. Was wir anbieten: Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens. Kontinuierliche persönliche Weiterentwicklung, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 €, das du in deine berufliche Entwicklung investieren kannst. About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

     

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, bringst dein Fachwissen in steuerliche und treasury-bezogene Themen ein und sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit und Stabilität. Bilanzierung & Jahresabschlüsse Du erstellst Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für mehrere Gesellschaften. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle und stellst eine korrekte buchhalterische Abbildung sicher. Du wirkst bei der Optimierung von Bilanzierungs- und Reportingprozessen mit. Finanzreporting & Steuern Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte sowie interner Reportings Du kümmerst dich um umsatz- und ertragssteuerliche Fragestellungen und deren Umsetzung. Du trägst zur Einhaltung steuerlicher Vorschriften und zur Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern bei. Treasury & Zahlungsverkehr Du unterstützt bei treasury-relevanten Aufgaben wie Zahlungsverkehr, Liquiditätsplanung und Bankabstimmungen. Du stellst eine strukturierte und termingerechte Abwicklung sicher. Tools & Prozessverbesserung Du arbeitest routiniert mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Lexware) sowie Google Workspace. Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen ein und sicherst eine hohe Datenqualität. Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung auf zukünftige Reporting- und Digitalisierungsvorhaben. Dein Profil Mindestens 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung oder Bilanzierung, idealerweise mit Verantwortung für Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB Fundiertes Verständnis buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Prozesse – von der Geschäftsvorfallbewertung über die Bilanzierung bis zur Erstellung von Abschlussdokumenten Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit MS Excel, Google Workspace und ERP-Systemen wie SAP, Lexware oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Finanzberichten, Gesellschafterinformationen und steuerlichen Meldungen Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Verlässlichkeit und ausgeprägte Diskretion im Umgang mit sensiblen Finanzdaten Strukturiertes Arbeiten innerhalb klar definierter Prozesse – du fühlst dich wohl in wiederkehrenden Abläufen mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch Teamorientierte, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einem präzisen und professionellen Kommunikationsstil Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
description: We Want You to Grow With Us   We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications. Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives. What We Can Offer   This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts. If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment. You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations. How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI   You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks. What You Will Do   Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay. Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa. Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC). Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation. Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates. Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions. Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers. Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements. Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications. What We Expect of You   Essential Skills & Experience   Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices. Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments. Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages. Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols. Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules. Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications. Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting. Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations. A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus. Valuable Experience   Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications. Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment. Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI. Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position. About Intersnack IT:   Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG .   About Intersnack Group:   Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. title: Werkstudent (M/W/D)
description: Was wir tun Als IoT-Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 50 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. Aktuell sind weltweit über 750.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet. Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten. Unser Team Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner der Industrie etabliert. Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen. Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Werkstudenten an den Standorten BISSENDORF bei Osnabrück), GARBSEN (bei Hannover)und BERLIN Einstieg als Werkstudent*In Werkstudent*innen arbeiten neben ihrem Studium in einem Unternehmen. Wenn Du Informatik oder ein ähnliches Studium absolvierst und gerne Software programmierst – könntest Du zu uns passen. Als Werkstudent*in wirst Du bei uns voll in die Arbeitsprozesse integriert, lernst strategisch zu denken, zu präsentieren, Projekte zu managen, eignest Dir Soft Skills an, wie den Umgang mit Kollegen*innen, Verhalten bei Stress und Kritikfähigkeit. Der Status als Werkstudent*in sorgt dafür, dass Du mehr Geld von Deinem Job behältst, denn als Werkstudent*in musst du keine Beiträge zur Kranken-, Pflege- und Arbeitslosenversicherung bezahlen. ES MÜSSEN VOR ALLEM ZWEI VORAUSSETZUNGEN ERFÜLLT SEIN, DAMIT DU ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN ANGEMELDET WERDEN KANNST UND VOM WERKSTUDENT*INNEN-PRIVILEG PROFITIERST: Du musst in einem Vollzeitstudium immatrikuliert sein (nicht im Urlaubssemester). Du darfst maximal 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit ist mehr möglich). Du bist neugierig auf das Berufsleben? Wir laden Dich ein, Teil unseres Teams zu werden! DEIN AUFGABENGEBIET ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Anwendungen im M2M / IoT-Umfeld. mit Java oder C/C++ auf embedded Linuxsystemen oder mit Java in der Backend-Entwicklung oder mit JavaScript in der Frontend-Entwicklung. Du nimmst an Schulungen teil und bildest dich eigenständig weiter. Du entwickelst Software im Team mit Tools wie GitLab, Maven, Node, JIRA, Confluence, u.a. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei laufenden Projekten. DEIN PROFIL Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt. Du bist wissbegierig und neue Technologien begeistern dich. Deine Freunde bezeichnen Dich als Nerd und das ist OK für dich. Du 'bastelst' gerne und hast Spaß daran mit Technologien Probleme des Alltags zu lösen. Du bist zuverlässig und arbeitest gewissenhaft. Du arbeitest gerne im Team Für dich ist geteiltes Wissen verdoppeltes Wissen. Wenn Du dich da wieder findest, kannst Du bei uns sicher einen Job finden, der Dich fachlich und Menschlich weiterbringt und dir dein Studium finanziell versüßt. Wir sind bestrebt unsere Werkstudent*innen auch nach dem Studim zu halten und freuen uns über alle studierenden, dessen Vertrag in einen festen Arbeitsvertrag übergeht. title: Product Manager MISSION AIRCRAFT (m/f/d)
description: About the role: As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming. You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes. Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps. Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming. Drive payload and mission-system integration such as radar, EO/IR, SIGINT, communications and other mission-specific payloads. Lead product trade-off decisions across performance, payload, endurance, platform constraints, cost, risk, certification and time-to-market. Own product readiness and lifecycle decisions, defining acceptance criteria and supporting validation, release readiness, market introduction and continuous product improvement. Create cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Programs, Sales, Product Marketing and external technology partners, clearly communicating priorities, dependencies, risks and roadmap decisions. What you bring to the team: You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of ... You already have at least X years of professional/practical experience in ... You are privately interested in ... Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert. You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently. Communication in English is a matter of course for you. Why Quantum-Systems: You have a degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field. You have several years of experience in technical Product Management, Systems Engineering or product development within aerospace, defence, UAS, aviation or another complex hardware-software environment. You have experience taking technically complex products or capabilities from customer need and concept through development, validation and market or operational deployment. You have a strong technical understanding and are comfortable working across aircraft systems, hardware, software, sensors, communications and mission-system integration. You have strong commercial judgement and can balance customer value, operational utility, technical feasibility, cost, schedule and product scalability. Ideally, you have experience with military aviation, UAS, ISR, Counter-UAS, mission systems, payload integration or manned-unmanned teaming. You are comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information and can bring structure and clarity to complex stakeholder discussions. Communicating in English comes naturally to you; German is a plus. Similar current Quantum Systems Product Manager roles require fluent English and treat German as advantageous. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Erreichung von Vertriebszielen und im Business Development. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägtes kommerzielles Verständnis und analytische Fähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen. Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen innerhalb der zugewiesenen Region. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld; Kenntnisse weiterer Sprachen sind von Vorteil. title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams. Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership. You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes. You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS. You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules. You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar). Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar). You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology?  Come join us! Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Technical Solutions Management owns the technical relationship with our strategic customers: we're the people their engineering leaders call first, and the people who get CoreWeave's delivery, operations, support and engineering teams moving for them.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Technical Solutions Manager, you'll own the technical relationship with a small number of strategic customers who are defining how AI gets built. Their deployments run to thousands of GPUs, often on hardware that is new to the whole industry. You'll be the customer's technical advocate inside CoreWeave from contract through delivery, onboarding and day-to-day operations, and you'll drive the programs that get their capacity into production.</p> <p>We're hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Staff TSMs take our largest, multi-site accounts and lead programs across the team.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the technical relationship with your customers' engineering and executive leaders, and be the person they trust to tell them what's really happening.</li> <li>Run delivery and onboarding programs end to end, from contract and site readiness to the day the customer runs production work on new capacity.</li> <li>Read each account's health every week, catch problems early, and drive cross-team issues to an owner and a resolution.</li> <li>Coordinate Fleet Operations, Capacity, data center, support and engineering teams on your customers' behalf, leading through influence.</li> <li>Carry customer needs into Product and Engineering and follow them through to a decision, then close the loop with the customer.</li> <li>Partner with account executives on one customer message, and with Specialist Field Engineers on technical depth.</li> <li>Help the team scale: improve our playbooks and tooling, interview, and mentor newer TSMs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years in technical program management, technical account management, solutions architecture, customer success engineering or professional services delivery with cloud infrastructure customers. For Staff, 8+ years and ownership of large, complex accounts.</li> <li>Experience owning the technical relationship with large customers, including their engineering and executive leaders.</li> <li>A track record of driving long-running, multi-team programs to a date and an outcome, with senior visibility.</li> <li>Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure: compute, networking, storage and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Strong written communication, both long form (plans, status reports, incident reviews) and short form (chat and email).</li> <li>Raises risk early, escalates with judgment, and stays calm under customer pressure.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with GPU clusters, HPC, or AI training and inference platforms.</li> <li>Familiarity with Slurm, InfiniBand or high-performance storage.</li> <li>Experience at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or AI hardware or systems vendor.</li> <li>Experience bringing up new data center capacity or new hardware generations for customers.</li> </ul> <p>Wondering if you're a good fit? Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You'd rather own the outcome than track the tasks.</li> <li>You can explain a hard technical trade-off to an engineer and to an executive in the same afternoon.</li> <li>You give customers bad news early and honestly, with a plan.</li> <li>You like building the process while you're running it.</li> </ul> <div> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</span></p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. The team owns regional go-to-market strategy and execution — high-touch account-based marketing, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions — and works cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Events, Brand, and Demand to drive customer acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Director of EMEA Field Marketing</strong> to own the customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy and execution across EMEA, and to establish CoreWeave as a recognized and trusted brand in the region.</p> <p>This role will lead and grow a team of regional marketing managers, and partner closely with sales leadership to align marketing investments and resourcing around the GEO go-to-market strategy supporting customer acquisition and customer expansion across enterprise and AI-natives. As leader of Field Marketing for EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our regional marketing strategy across high-touch account-based marketing, 3rd party conferences, field programs, executive engagement, and partner-led motions.</p> <p>This role will own how CoreWeave shows up in the region — building awareness and credibility with European AI-native builders and enterprise buyers, and adapting the global brand narrative for a market with distinct data sovereignty, regulatory, language, and cultural requirements. Your leadership will drive the expansion of CoreWeave's presence and reputation in the dynamic and rapidly evolving EMEA AI-Cloud market.</p> <p>Success is measured by pipeline created and progressed, conversion rates across the funnel, deal velocity in priority accounts, and growth in regional brand awareness and consideration among target accounts.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <h3><strong>Regional Strategy &amp; Pipeline Ownership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the EMEA customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy end to end, carrying accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline targets by segment, country, and priority account.</li> <li>Align marketing investment and team resourcing to the GEO go-to-market strategy, ensuring the regional plan reflects where Sales is prioritizing acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.</li> <li>Balance investment between near-term pipeline generation and the brand and category-building work required to make CoreWeave a known quantity in EMEA, and be able to articulate the tradeoff.</li> <li>Set the channel mix across ABM, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions based on ROI analysis and attribution data.</li> <li>Build distinct motions for acquisition and expansion: net-new account penetration and category presence on one side, deeper multi-workload engagement within existing customers on the other.</li> <li>Prioritize across a multi-country region — sequencing investment across core markets and emerging ones rather than spreading coverage thin.</li> <li>Manage a multi-million dollar regional budget with explicit ROI rationale, and defend allocation and resourcing decisions to marketing and sales leadership.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Brand Presence &amp; Market Development in EMEA</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own CoreWeave's overall brand presence in EMEA — partnering with the Brand, Communications, and Product Marketing teams to build awareness, credibility, and consideration in a market where CoreWeave is still establishing itself.</li> <li>Adapt the global brand narrative for regional realities: data sovereignty and residency, EU regulatory context, local infrastructure footprint, language and cultural nuance — without fragmenting the global story.</li> <li>Land regional proof points — customer stories, local infrastructure milestones, partner wins — and make them visible in-market.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Sales Partnership &amp; Account-Based Marketing</strong></h3> deals.</li> <li>Build expansion programs alongside Sales and Customer teams that deepen engagement in existing accounts and surface new workloads, teams, and buying centers.</li> </ul> technical and developer-led moments where CoreWeave should show up — and holding each to a pipeline and brand thesis.</li> <li>Partner with the Executive Marketing team to connect regional CXO and VP engagement to opportunity progression in named accounts.</li> <li>Work with Partner Marketing to activate partner-led motions in-region — including the regional systems integrators, resellers, and cloud and ecosystem partners that carry disproportionate weight in EMEA — turning joint narratives into named-account plays and co-sell pipeline.</li> <li>Provide clear regional input into global campaigns and launches so they land effectively with EMEA audiences and buyer personas, and flag where regional adaptation is required.</li> <li>Partner with Developer Marketing to grow developer advocacy and engagement with in EMEA communities&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Data-Driven Optimization &amp; Scalable Systems</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage the KPIs that matter — account and contact initiatives.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experienced regional marketing leader:</strong> 10+ years in B2B marketing at high-growth technology or enterprise In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR.
